title: feat: infer delimiter from fence_type attr and file extension
description:
Closes #6

## Summary

- `format_front_matter()` and `write_front_matter()` now infer the delimiter when `delimiter = NULL`, using the `fence_type` attribute preserved by `parse_front_matter()`/`read_front_matter()` for seamless roundtrips
- Falls back to an extension-based map (`.sql` → `yaml_sql_block_compact`, `.py` → `toml_pep723`, `.R` → `yaml_roxy`, `.md`/`.qmd`/`.Rmd` → `yaml`)
- Expands documentation with a Roundtrip Support section and updated examples

title: feat: support shebang lines before front matter
description:
Closes #5

## Summary
Adds support for parsing front matter in scripts that begin with a shebang line (`#!/usr/bin/env ...`). The C++ parser now detects and skips a shebang on line 1 (tolerating 0 or 1 blank lines between the shebang and the opening fence) before looking for comment-prefixed front matter (`# ---`, `#' ---`, or PEP 723 `# /// script`). Standard `---`/`+++` fences preceded by a shebang return `NULL` as before. The shebang line is preserved in the returned `body` so the script remains valid and executable.

`format_front_matter()` and `write_front_matter()` are updated to hoist the shebang to the top of the output when round-tripping, using tight spacing (no blank line between the shebang and the opening fence). Shebang hoisting is restricted to the known comment-prefixed formats only.

## Verification

```r
library(frontmatter)

script <- "#!/usr/bin/env Rscript
# ---
# title: My Script
# author: Garrick
# ---
cat('hello')"

result <- parse_front_matter(script)
result$data$title  #> [1] "My Script"
result$body        #> starts with #!/usr/bin/env Rscript
```

title: Add SQL front matter support
description:
## Summary

- Add SQL front matter parsing for two comment styles: line comments (`-- ---`/`-- +++`) and block comments (`/* --- ... --- */` compact and `/*` + `---` expanded forms)
- Wire SQL delimiter shortcuts into `write_front_matter()` for roundtrip support with six new formats: `yaml_sql_line`, `toml_sql_line`, `yaml_sql_block_compact`, `toml_sql_block_compact`, `yaml_sql_block_expanded`, `toml_sql_block_expanded`
- Fix `trim_leading_comment_lines` to strip at most one bare comment separator line, preventing roundtrip data loss for bodies starting with bare comment markers (applies to all comment-wrapped formats)

### SQL line comments

```sql
-- ---
-- title: Sales Report
-- author: Data Team
-- ---

SELECT * FROM sales
```

### SQL block comments (compact)

```sql
/* ---
title: Sales Report
author: Data Team
--- */

SELECT * FROM sales
```

### SQL block comments (expanded)

```sql
/*
---
title: Sales Report
author: Data Team
---
*/

SELECT * FROM sales
```
